description: Ability to use and lead teams using digital tools and platforms for scanning data assets, assessing operational feasibility, and integrating cross-program requirements.

change to work: Plans and recommendations will need to be grounded in fast, collaborative reviews of available assets, and transparent alignment with agency priorities. Outcomes and resource trade-offs must be explicitly documented.
justification: Plans for improvement are currently broader, lacking evidence-centric criteria or real-time asset evaluation.

description: Ability to assess, prioritize, and leverage internal/external data assets for statistical program objectives; familiarity with repository/inventory systems and governance.

change to work: Objectively defining study objectives will require explicit evaluation of automation and digital options before recommending any manual/survey-based approaches. Study standards and definitions must now include interoperability and automation-readiness criteria.
justification: Current element emphasizes statistical content and approach without systematic automation or digital workflow evaluation.

change to work: Assessment and recommendation must now weigh digital and automation guardrails, minimizing respondent burden and maximizing reuse and digital execution alignment. Approval logic incorporates cost/benefit and systematic trade-off documentation.

description: Skill in leading and integrating IT, automation, and workflow specialists in statistical project teams from project outset.

change to work: Cross-functional leadership expands to include IT and automation experts from project inception, requiring familiarity with digital collaboration norms and technical project stakeholder management.
justification: Representation previously limited to statistical/programmatic scope; new requirement is IT/project automation integration.

description: Expertise in the structure, management, and evaluation of metadata repositories and interoperability protocols is required to arbitrate and validate digital concepts.

change to work: Shift from direct creation of standards/concepts to validation, arbitration, and exception management of AI/machine-suggested frameworks. Decisions must now justify deviation from automated recommendations with reference to interoperability and sector needs.
justification: Current requirement emphasizes traditional development; transition to AI-supported decision-making demands understanding of both underlying technical systems and advanced metadata structures.

description: Ability to mediate, interpret, and make exception decisions between multiple machine-suggested concept definitions balancing enterprise harmonization and sectoral needs.
historic work: Technical Activities: 1. DECISION MAKING (Defines the objectives and content of the studies and the overall approach to be followed; determines the standards, data concepts, definitions and techniques to be applied…)
change to work: Shift from direct creation of standards/concepts to validation, arbitration, and exception management of AI/machine-suggested frameworks. Decisions must now justify deviation from automated recommendations with reference to interoperability and sector needs.
justification: Increased emphasis on arbitration and harmonization rather than only creation or selection.

description: Proficiency in documenting exceptions to proposed standards in a way that supports auditability, traceability, and systematic digital governance.
historic work: Technical Activities: 1. DECISION MAKING (Develops enhancements and recommends modifications to be made to the program content, coverage and operational procedures…)
change to work: Modifications now derive from mediation between machine suggestions, user needs, and program harmony, requiring rationale for configurable exceptions and better integration of interoperable standards.
justification: Gap in ability to frame and document exceptions to machine-driven standards in an interoperable context.

description: Capacity to assess and communicate how harmonized, machine-suggested concepts affect program findings and sectoral recommendations.
historic work: Technical Activities: 1. DECISION MAKING (Interprets study findings and conclusions and prepares recommendations… on significant factors related to the changing environment)
change to work: Interpretations must integrate digital traceability of concept changes, and recommendations should reference harmonization and interoperability impacts.
justification: Understanding ramifications of machine-based harmonization on findings and environment analysis.

description: Skill in managing teams where machine and human input interleave, ensuring transparency, mitigation of bias, and harmonization goals.
historic work: Technical Activities: 2. LEADERSHIP AND OPERATIONAL MANAGEMENT (Manages a unit, determines program objectives/priorities, resolves conflicting priorities)
change to work: Must now include leadership for machine-human hybrid workflows, new conflict types (human-vs-AI, cross-program automated outputs), and harmonization enforcement.
justification: Need for advanced negotiation and change-management skills within an AI-supported operational context.

description: Ability to clearly explain AI-driven harmonization decisions and exceptions to stakeholders with varying technical backgrounds.
historic work: Technical Activities: 3. COMMUNICATION (Represents subject-matter divisions on development projects, participates in cross-departmental committees, provides guidance)
change to work: Focus will expand to justifying AI-driven harmonization, arbitrating system conflicts, and communicating complex standards decisions to technical and non-technical groups.
justification: Increased communication complexity in explaining machine-driven processes and justifying exceptions.

development area: Knowledge of Automated Suitability Assessment Systems
description: Ability to interpret, validate, and communicate the outputs of platform-based suitability and data assessment processes.
historic work: Key Activities: 'Coordinates and reviews the development, processing, analysis, marketing and dissemination of statistical data; prepares, edits and evaluates analytical material for publication purposes.'
change to work: Update is required to reflect a greater emphasis on oversight and validation of automated analytical/assessment systems, transitioning team activities to monitoring, curating, and publishing assessments/results generated by those systems rather than manual analysis.
justification: This activity will require understanding how automated outputs are generated and how to critically evaluate their credibility and completeness for publication.

description: Skill in integrating, reviewing, and acting on suitability assessments provided by advanced automated platforms.
historic work: Key Activities: 'Determines changes in the statistical needs of clients; assesses the impact on divisional programs; develops options and strategies to manage complex issues and multi-stakeholder relations.'
change to work: Shift is necessary from conducting manual needs assessments and options development to analyzing outputs and recommendations from automated suitability tools, balancing technical evidence with stakeholder management.
justification: Understanding the operation and limits of automated assessment tools and how they integrate with stakeholder input.

development area: Interpretation of Automated Data Source Rankings
description: Skill in reviewing and justifying program changes based on evidence and analytics from automated data suitability and prioritization systems.

change to work: Decision making moves from direct research of new data sources to interpreting the results of technology-aided source prioritization, and shifting recommendations to those validated by automated processes and partnership analyses.

description: Ability to build and lead teams organized around partnership maintenance, legal/ethical vetting, metadata curation, and integration with automated assessment processes.
historic work: Technical Activities, Skills, Responsibilities, or Efforts: 2.
